scope: Cleanup native-unique replacement regression fixture masking only

findings.description: The alternate-primary-key INSERT OR REPLACE subcase uses stop_operation_id=replacement, which is not a real dispatch claim. Migration 0021:9 requires that key to exist in product_dispatch_claims, and the real connection enables foreign_keys. If only the native-unique replacement guard were removed, the invalid FK could still raise sqlite3.IntegrityError and make this subcase appear to prove that guard.
findings.production_assessment: The current migration explicitly guards both the original primary key and provider/account/native target uniqueness. This finding does not demonstrate a production replacement defect or invalidate the static guard implementation; it identifies a masked regression oracle.
findings.minimal_strengthening: After the active frozen run, change only the alternate stop_operation_id to self.flow.entry_operation. It is a genuine claimed ENTRY from the same run, unused as a cleanup primary key. Keep original provider_ref/account_ref/native_algo_id, close_operation_id, generation, identity/source JSON and their audit hashes unchanged. Assert the entry claim exists and no cleanup row has that alternate key before attempting replacement.
findings.why_alternative_is_valid: GenuineProtectedCloseContext:45-50 obtains entry_operation from the actual entered helper. TradingCloseV02Tests.entered:21-25 calls the real service.execute then reconcile, so the dispatch claim is committed. The migration does not add a role CHECK or identity-JSON/column CHECK; therefore this controlled SQL test alternative satisfies the relevant FKs without inventing an owner financial state. With recursive_triggers OFF, removal of the native-unique BEFORE INSERT guard would then permit the unique-key replacement instead of failing on the unrelated missing FK.
findings.desired_oracle: Current production trigger rejects and original row remains unchanged; a bounded isolated mutation removing only the native-unique condition should make the rejection assertion fail, with rollback/cleanup restoring the owned fixture.

active_run_policy: No source or candidate mutation now. Preserve current run/results and prior review artifacts; strengthen and execute the regression only afterward under root ownership.
